spans.s:
जिष् जिष्, cl. 1. P. जेषति, &c., to
sprinkle; [cf. विष् and मिष्.]

जिष्णु जिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. 1. जि), vic-
torious, triumphant, gaining, winning; (with acc. or
at end of comp.) vanquishing, conquering, excelling;
(उस्), m. the sun; an epithet of Indra, of Viṣṇu,
and of Arjuna; N. of a Vasu; N. of a son of Manu
Bhautya, N. of the father of Brahma-gupta; [cf.
परा-जिष्णु.]
